compiled_state.title: Update COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md to non-blocking fast-feedback model
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, the commit workflow runs tests, lint, and format for fast feedback but does not block on failures — no review gate or test gate enforcement locally
- DD4: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3.5 fully removed; full COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md update to non-blocking fast-feedback

## Implementation Plan

Update `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md`:

1. Remove Step 3 (Load Enforcement Profile) entirely OR convert to a note explaining that enforcement.strategy=ci is always in effect
2. Remove the enforcement-gated comment blocks (lines ~148 and ~164) that reference Steps 5/6 of commit-workflow-validation.md as gated by enforcement.strategy
3. Remove or rewrite any references to review-status, test-gate-status, record-test-status, and the two-layer review gate
4. Update the document to describe the simplified commit workflow:
   - Step 1-2: standard pre-checks (tickets, formatting)
   - Fast-feedback: run tests, lint, format as advisory warnings (non-blocking)
   - Commit proceeds without enforcement gates
   - CI enforcement happens on the PR side
5. Update COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3.5 section if it exists as a standalone step

Also check and update `tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh` if it validates removed steps — update the canonical list to reflect the new simplified workflow.

Also check `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md` if it exists — remove enforcement-strategy-gated sections.

## Test Approach
Given: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md has been updated to remove all enforcement-gate references
When: grep is run on the updated file for enforcement gate keywords
Then: no matches are found for 'enforcement.strategy', 'review-status', 'test-gate-status'

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md does not reference enforcement-strategy-gated blocks
  Verify: ! grep -q 'enforcement.strategy=local' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md does not reference review-status or test-gate-status artifacts
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'review-status|test-gate-status' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh updated if it referenced removed steps
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh (full suite passes)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
